applies_to: gameplay.item_state exact replay when the patch major is >= 16 (ItemStateIndex with patch); 15.x replays never read this file
source: 16.15 KR ranked solo (queue 420), 553 matches, D:/LOL_Project/fusion_2615/raw/kr/{detail,timeline}: timeline ITEM_* events and detail item0-6 / roleBoundItem / teamPosition / pre-game summoner spells; evidence counts below were produced by scripts/exact_v4/ev4_s1x_items_16x.py evidence

mid_tier3_boots.upgrade: gameplay.item_state.tier3_boots_map (tier-2 boots -> the 'into' item built only from it with gold_base 0)

not_granted.2150: Elixir of Skill at level 9 needs a free normal slot (16.15: no 2150 event for 211/212 Triple Tonic players with >= 6 occupied normal slots at level 9, an event for 616/641 with a free slot); not modelled: no stats and 0 gold in Data Dragon, destroyed a median 2.3 s after the level-up

rules.rule: role-quest item at 0 ms by slot role (pid 1-5 / 6-10 = TOP, JUNGLE, MIDDLE, BOTTOM, UTILITY): TOP 1222 when Teleport (12) is a pre-game summoner spell else 1200, JUNGLE 1204, MIDDLE 1201, BOTTOM 1202, UTILITY 1203; it occupies the role-bound slot (detail roleBoundItem), not item0-5

a destroy of a held quest token turns it into its reward: 1200 -> 1220, 1222 -> 1221, 1201 -> 1206, 1202 -> 1207, 1204 -> 1209 (the jungle pet destroyed at that ms is consumed); a destroy of a held placeholder 1207 / 1208 (or 1203 outside its completion ms) removes it

support ward slot: 1203 -> 1208 when 3866 is destroyed at that ms (quest completion; a 3866 destroy while the slot holds a ward switches the placeholder silently); a 2055 destroy at the ms of a 1203 / 1208 destroy is the bought ward moving into the slot (not a removal); when the player's last 2055 leaves (placed, sold, undone) the placeholder of the current stage (1203 / 1208) comes back without an event

mid quest: from the ms of the 1201 destroy on, a loose destroy of a held tier-2 boots turns it into its free tier-3 upgrade (item_state.tier3_boots_map: the 'into' item built only from it with gold_base 0; 3006 -> 3172 although 3172 has no Boots tag); a 'destroy X' listed before 'buy X' at one ms is moved after the purchase (the game upgrades the new boots at once)
bot quest: a loose boots destroy at the ms of a 1207 destroy is the boots moving into the role slot (not a removal)
2001 Recall / 2002 Enhanced Recall events are dropped: never purchased, never in item0-6 at game end, no stats; created without events after the team's Baron / Herald / Dragon kills
trinket slot: 3340 at 0 ms; a trinket purchase without a same-ms trinket destroy replaces the held trinket (its undo gives it back)
Eye of the Herald: a loose trinket destroy (no trinket bought at that ms) at the ms of a 2001 / 2002 destroy puts 3513 into the trinket slot; the 3513 destroy gives the stored trinket back
ITEM_UNDO with beforeId 0 and afterId 0 undoes the player's last purchase (the item or its immediate tier-3 upgrade) and restores what it consumed

Viego: a destroy group that would be a possession swap is his own quest completing when it holds a destroy of his own quest-chain item and at most one other loose destroy; the R16-8 herald exchange is not a swap either

rules.note: not 16.x-specific (2010 removals of an unowned item are listed for 15.14 too); applied only for patch major >= 16 to keep 15.x byte-identical
